title: A Rug With Some Pros And Cons
text: A Rug With Some Pros And Cons. There are some strong pros for this rug. It is thick, soft, very sturdy, and is nice to use on a floor that otherwise gets cold in winter. There is one con though, that brings this rug down to a three star rating for me. There is what appears to be a subtle design on the rug. Under closer examination though, the design looks like it was cut out with an x-acto knife, leaving ragged edges that may be prone to fraying. If it wasn't for that, I'd have to give this rug at least four stars, if not five.

product_metadata.title: Revival Rugs - 4'x6' Shell Kitchen Rug - Machine Washable Area Rug – Medium Pile 100% Recycled Polyester – Oeko-TEX Certified, Beige/Cream
features: SHELL AREA RUG: Shell is a solid-color rug with geometric line drawings in relief; the modern rug’s simple tone-on-tone effect is inspired by the accidental designs of beach tides
MACHINE WASHABLE: Keeping your area rug in pristine condition couldn’t be easier – our machine washable rugs can be line dried and returned to your floor looking good as new

MEDIUM PILE: This is not a thin, flat mat: it’s a thick, soft and cushioned medium pile rug; made of 100% recycled polyester and OEKO-TEX certified, the rug is soft underfoot and has a grippy base for safety
NEUTRAL TONES: Effortlessly complementing any modern décor, this understated rug combines neutral bone beige tones; our designer perfects each style and hue to create the right mood

REVIVAL RUGS: Not all rugs are created equally; our new collections of kitchen, living room and bedroom rugs and runners are fresh off the loom, woven in limited editions, and designed in collaboration with artisan partners
